svg.title: ODDCHAPTER — LINK refinement preview
svg.text: Same concept, tightened. Nothing was redesigned; one parameter moved.
centres 42 u apart · junction lens 12 u
centres 44 u apart · junction lens 10 u
Why: at 42 the lens tips came to within 1 unit
of the counters, pinching the junction. At 44 the
letters read separately while still interlocking.
dashed = protected drawing box 98 × 54 u · crosses = letter centres
The junction is the mathematical intersection of two
annuli — no drawn shape, so it can never drift.
monogram height = 1.5 × cap height · gap = 0.62 × cap
tagline: Inter SemiBold · +0.17 em · rule above is the only accent
clear space = 1 × stroke (13 u) on all four sides
Minimum digital size: 32 px high for the monogram; 24 px is the hard floor.
Minimum print size: 8 mm wide. In favicon-less contexts the junction is the first thing to go — expected, not a defect.
Refined preview only. No YouTube, social, thumbnail or motion asset has been produced yet.
vector masters · no raster master · wordmark outlined
